name: CYNTHIAS OF BEND
address: 1245 SE 3RD ST STE B-1, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure; Street Frontage; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Single Access Point; Limited Rear Access; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the street.
• Keep the primary access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles on both sides and overhead.
• Install a reflective address marker at the detached structure so responders can identify it as a separate building on the property.
• Keep the perimeter fence gate nearest to the rear of the property unlocked or equipped with a breakaway latch to allow responder access when rear entry is needed.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the perimeter fencing to allow responders to move along the fence line on foot.
• Mark any secondary access points on the street frontage with reflective indicators so arriving responders can identify all available entry points.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear to allow responders to move between buildings quickly.
• Designate and keep clear a flat, firm area near the access drive where emergency vehicles can stage without blocking the primary route.
• Trim shrubs and trees in landscaped areas adjacent to the main residence so responders can move around the building perimeter without obstruction.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Grass Cover; Scattered Trees; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Mow or cut the grass near the structures before it dries out and becomes a fire hazard.
• Trim the lower branches of scattered trees near the structures to reduce the chance of fire climbing from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Keep shrubs separated from each other and from structures so fire cannot easily spread between them.
• Remove any dead or dry grass buildup that collects against fences, walls, or other structures.
• Keep the area directly around structures clear of dry grass and loose plant material.
